verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ironclad has a documented REST API (Records, Workflows, OAuth2, webhooks) but no mention of official client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS/Node libraries), and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all returned 404s, suggesting no first-class SDK tooling exists. missing for 10: evidence of any named official SDK/client library, language-specific packages, or OpenAPI-based codegen support.
